# Scripts

Small scripts I run by hand or from cron.

- [backup-home.sh](backup-home.sh): copy Documents to the backup drive
- [backup-music.sh](backup-music.sh): copy the music library to the backup drive
- [clear-tmp.sh](clear-tmp.sh): remove week-old files from /tmp
- [rotate-logs.sh](rotate-logs.sh): compress and expire old logs
- [resize-photos.sh](resize-photos.sh): web-sized copies of the JPEGs in a folder
- [rename-by-date.sh](rename-by-date.sh): rename JPEGs to the date they were taken

The cron lines are in crontab.txt.
